default.name: Offlimits preventielijn (voorheen Stop it Now)
default.conf: Anonymous and free. Callers do not need to identify themselves. Offlimits states that nothing is reported to law enforcement; the general Dutch duty to report acute danger does not extend to anonymous helpline conversations (as stated by Offlimits / organisers' legal-confidentiality data). Confirm wording on site — docs/04 V1.

alternatives.name: Stop It Now! UK & Ireland
alternatives.conf: Confidential helpline run by the Lucy Faithfull Foundation. Sourced from service guarantee.

alternatives.name: Stop It Now! US
alternatives.conf: Confidential helpline guidance provided by Stop It Now coalition with narrow statutory exceptions for imminent child harm.

alternatives.name: Stop It Now! Australia
alternatives.conf: Confidential prevention helpline operated by the Australian Centre for Child Protection (ACCP).

default.name: Preventell (Karolinska Institutet)
default.conf: Free, anonymous national helpline operated by Karolinska Institutet. Protected under Swedish healthcare statutory secrecy (OSL 25:1).

default.name: Kein Täter werden / Dunkelfeld
default.conf: Free, confidential prevention programme for people who are attracted to children and want help before anything happens. Treatment is confidential; the programme states it does not report participants to police. Confirm wording on site - docs/04 V1.
